summary: Frontend-only verification after Sprint V1.0 Safe Cleanup (deleted AiDesigner + 30 shadcn UI files + 38 npm packages, added Share Flyer button). Public homepage loads with 110 data-testids and all 11 sections rendered in correct order. Admin login with rotated password works, redirects to /dashboard. All 7 dashboard tabs (Home, Workspace, Menu, Promote, Library, Layout, Customers) render with no runtime console errors — confirming the 38-package removal did not break the dependency graph. Home tab shows Studio landing with Quick Actions, Today at a glance, Budget card, and dashboard testids present. Menu tab renders Today's Pick + all category testids (appetizers, burgers, tacos, etc.). Layout, Library, and Customers tabs render as expected. Photo→Flyer wizard reachable via Promote tab (step 1 landing shown). New Share Flyer button verified in source at PhotoToFlyer.jsx lines 1415-1421 with correct testid `photo-flyer-share-flyer` positioned between `photo-flyer-download-flyer` and `photo-flyer-regenerate` (Share2 icon, onClick=onShareClick). Could not reach step 4 (Done) at runtime without generating a job — accepted per review instructions (source-code inspection allowed). All 5 public API endpoints return 200.
critical_code_review_comments: PhotoToFlyer.jsx is 1903 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Should be split into wizard-step subcomponents in a future refactor (already flagged as re-deferred router-split follow-up).

Public homepage section testids follow `<name>-section` convention (hero-section, specials-section, etc.) rather than plain names as described in the review request; not a bug but review request wording is slightly inaccurate. Order verified correct.
